claim: Gouveio the citrus, the last being the grape Madeira calls Verdelho.
because: Gouveio is the Douro name for Godello, the same variety as Verdelho do Dão. It is a different variety from Madeira's Verdelho. Older ampelography, such as Truel (1984), wrongly treated Gouveio as a synonym of Madeira Verdelho, and Portuguese Portaria 428/2000 renamed it Gouveio to end that confusion. DNA profiling confirms that Godello/Gouveio and Madeira Verdelho are separate varieties. The error also matters here because Verdelho appears in distractor D.
fix: Rabigato brings the acidity, Viosinho the body and Gouveio the citrus, the last being the grape Spain calls Godello (and not, despite an old confusion, the Verdelho of Madeira).
